runtime_policy: Exact reviewed definition, daily basis, sex, age, life-stage and KFA applicability; no implicit US activity mapping, no clinical defaults, no interpolation.

comparisons.reason: Total by difference includes fibre; no implicit fibre subtraction.

comparisons.condition: Reviewed available-carbohydrate target; source method policy remains explicit.

comparisons.reason: RE and RAE use different provitamin conversion conventions.
Preformed niacin excludes the tryptophan contribution to niacin equivalents.
Equivalence requires source-specific definition review; identical mg units do not establish equivalence.
Do not infer dietary folate equivalents from an unspecified folate label.

publication_note: This file publishes no numeric population norms. ReviewedRussianReferenceTable is a trusted domain boundary, not an external-payload authorization mechanism. A publisher must verify evidence and review before constructing it.
scope_limits: Scalar reviewed references only; inequalities and ranges require an explicit separate contract.
Age in completed years only; infant month-specific references unsupported.
